name: io.github.conorbronsdon/apple-podcasts-mcp
title: Apple Podcasts MCP Server
description: Apple Podcasts Connect owner analytics over the Reporter protocol: plays, followers, per-episode listening. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Reporter access token from Apple Podcasts Connect (Settings > Access Token). Expires 180 days after it is generated.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_VENDOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Vendor number from Apple Podcasts Connect Settings, e.g. 87654321

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PODCASTS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple account number. Only needed when the access token can read more than one account, which Reporter reports as error 214.
